name: Lolikko Kunoichi Midara Ninpouchou
original_name: ロリっ娘くのいち 淫ら忍法帳
source:
Falling pray to a trick, the girls' bodies find themselves blushing and twisted up with pleasure!

Loli-kko Kunoichi is a strange historical drama with the sexual magic "Inpo" at the core.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE037538.html]DLSite English[/url]]

The year is 1792. Sakura is a kunoichi, a female ninja fighting for honor, love, and justice. She discovers that her friend Momo is prostituting herself in order to save her parents store! She decides to rescue her friend but the temptation of pleasure is hard to resist.
